title: העכביש שעף בלי כנפיים — מאות קילומטרים, על חוטי משי
summary: Ballooning spiders: Darwin's Beagle (1832) covered in spiders ~60 miles offshore, the lone spider on Krakatoa (1884), like charges repel so silk threads fan out, the global electric circuit (~100 V/m fair weather, Tel Aviv University stations at Mitzpe Ramon and Hermon), field enhancement at sharp tips, Morley & Robert's 2018 windless-box experiment (Erigone, trichobothria; electric fields sufficient, not proven necessary); voltage = field × height and m/s → km/h, with a miles→km→hours challenge.
reviewer_verdict: PASS (2 rounds) — nits left: older track still ~1,500 words (est. 30–33 min with the optional challenge); kit lint/check missing from the repo so local stand-ins were used; Arto and the AI grader not exercised on file://; review copy doesn't declare the sample capability (template)
